verdict.rationale: GitHub docs explicitly state 'No API key management - just sign in with your Google account,' directly matching the story, and this aligns with the free daily quota developers report abusing (comm-12). However, community reports of subscription-tier confusion (comm-3, comm-19) and a login failure for Workspace accounts (comm-5) suggest some friction beyond the simple personal-account flow. Missing for 10: independent hands-on walkthrough confirming smooth personal-account onboarding and clear documentation of free-tier limits.
